topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes students and outlines the lecture's focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition and Receptor Signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms and receptor signaling pathways by which the innate immune system detects pathogens and cellular damage.

topics.label: Leukocyte Recruitment and Inflammatory Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how initial inflammatory activation drives leukocyte recruitment, lymphatic trafficking, and systemic physiological effects.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the body terminates acute inflammation, repairs damaged tissue, and manages persistent chronic inflammation.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the subject of the next session.
